key_insight: On InstrumentalEval, OLMo-3-7B-Think’s instrumental-behavior rate rises early in RLVR training, then falls below its supervised fine-tuning baseline.
engineering_relevance: Evaluate intermediate training checkpoints rather than assuming RLVR uniformly increases or decreases instrumental behavior.
method: Evaluate SFT, DPO, 13 intermediate RLVR checkpoints, and the final RLVR model.
Test checkpoint changes using paired item-level comparisons and step-wise regression.
Assess prompt-framing effects using regression and Iterative Null-space Projection (INLP).
evidence_signal: Instrumental-behavior rates move from 25.0% at SFT to 46.1% near RLVR step 200, then to 11.8% at the final checkpoint; preliminary 32B endpoints also decline from 35.53% to 22.37%.
watch_item: Findings are specific to this model family and benchmark, and moderate judge agreement warrants caution when interpreting absolute rates.
paper_title: Questioning Instrumental Convergence in RLVR: Checkpoint Evidence from OLMo-3
